A finished call replays as 409, not twice

posts.text: A paid x402 call on three.ws/docs/x402 that fails after settlement no longer asks the buyer to pay again. The response carries paid: true and retry_safe: true; repeat the exact request with the same X-PAYMENT header and the server skips verify and settle, re-runs the work and answers with the original x-payment-response header. 3 retries inside 24 hours by default; after that the route answers 409 payment_retries_exhausted and the settlement transaction, which landed on @solana, is in the body for support.

Routes under /api/x402/* run the work before settling, so a handler that fails charges nothing. A call that completed is different: replaying its proof answers 409 payment_replayed, and buying the result again needs a new payment.
